title: Eleven Parishes and One Border
subtitle: 行政区划 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 行政区划（社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：行政区划（社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：county　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 county 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 my grandmother ① crossed into a county that began at the eleventh milestone, and she said the crossing was the whole of the errand. The ② county, meaning the shire and not the border, held eleven parishes and stayed that number; county, she said, is the only thing on a road that is judged by how quietly it begins.

Every ③ county in that region had the same record office, and the ④ county at the end, meaning the one she kept for the births and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever wrote to twice. County, my mother said, is nine parts record office and one part somebody willing to write; my grandmother said the writing is the part that fills the errand.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the county was the whole of the match, meaning the team and not the shire. The ⑥ county, meaning the team and not any of that, is the only thing in a match that everybody supports and nobody pays; county, he said, is either something you cross into or the only word that means both a shire and a team. She said the team is the part they remember.

By 1960 the ⑦ county had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the record office. The ⑧ county of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in May, was one milestone and thirty years of writing; county, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to write. He said the writing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ county I remember is the one at the end, which she wrote to in 1966 and is still described as the quietest in the region. A ⑩ county, my mother said in 1968, is the only thing that improves by being written to; every county, she said, is a team that has agreed to look like a shire. She said the team was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 郡；县（行政区划）
B. n. 郡（指那个郡本身，与那条边界相对）
C. 固定搭配：cross into a county 进入某个郡
D. n. 郡（指那个地区里每一个）
E. n. 郡（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 郡代表队；县队（体育比赛中的郡队）
G. n. 郡（指登记册里提到的那一个）
H. n. 郡治；地方行政区（抽象总称）

items.q: crossed into a county that began at the eleventh milestone
The county, meaning the shire and not the border
the county was the whole of the match
the county had become a line in a register
The county of the whole thing
A county, my mother said in 1968

answers.why: cross into a county 意为“进入某个郡”，1952 年祖母进入了一个从第十一个里程碑开始的郡。
county 意为“郡”，指那个郡本身而不是那条边界，辖有十一个教区。
county 指那个地区里每一个郡，每一个都用同一所档案室。
county 指末尾那一个（她为出生登记找的那一个），是唯一有人写过两次信的。
county 意为“郡代表队、县队”，父亲说郡队就是那场比赛的全部，指的是代表队而不是那个郡。
county 为体育用法，指郡代表队而不是那个郡，是比赛里人人都支持、却无人付钱的东西。
county 意为“郡”，指登记册里提到的那一个，到 1960 年这个郡成了登记册里的一行。
county 意为“郡治、地方行政区”，祖母五月写道，整件事的地方行政区是一个里程碑三十年的写信。
county 意为“郡、县”，我记得的是末尾那一个，她 1966 年写信去过，至今仍被说成全地区最安静的。
county 为抽象总称，母亲说一个郡是唯一会因为被写信询问而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年祖母进入了一个从第十一个里程碑开始的郡，她说跨进去才是这整趟差事的全部。（cross into a county）
那个郡，指的是那个郡本身而不是那条边界，辖有十一个教区，并且一直是那个数。（county）
那个地区里每一个郡都用同一所档案室。（county）
末尾那一个郡，指的是她为出生登记找的那一个，是唯一有人写过两次信的。（county）
父亲说郡队就是那场比赛的全部，指的是代表队而不是那个郡。（county）
1968 年母亲说，一个郡是唯一会因为被写信询问而变好的东西。（county）

The county, meaning the shire and not the border, held eleven parishes and stayed that number.
Every county in that region had the same record office.
The county at the end, meaning the one she kept for the births and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever wrote to twice.
My father said the county was the whole of the match, meaning the team and not the shire.
A county, my mother said in 1968, is the only thing that improves by being written to.
